messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired PDINC-2026-142: embeddings-service (eu-west-1) - elevated 5xx rate and p95 latency > 10s. Trigger: 5xx_rate > 1% over 2m. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PDINC-2026-142
Ashley: ack on PD, I'm taking initial triage. assigning on-call for embed pipeline. digging into autoscaler + kv cache. I'll post findings.
Mike: available to help if this needs tier2 (can take after quick triage). ping me @mike
Ashley: thanks. quick checks:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep embed
# shows multiple CrashLoopBackOff and OOMKilled on embedder-2/4
```
Ashley: we also see redis connection errors in logs:
```
ERROR redis_client: ConnectionError('read timeout') trace id=abc123
ERROR embed_worker: failed to write shard cache
```
Jordan: seeing a big CPU spike on the embedding pods at the time of the page (03:12z). traces show a goroutine leak in kv-cache flush loop.
Laura: heads up support — customers hitting generation timeouts in EU region, slow UI. opening initial customer comms: "We're investigating degraded performance in EU; engineers on it." I'll add any impacted org IDs once Mike/Ashley confirm.
Ashley: trying a quick mitigation: scale replicas to 6 -> 12 and restart failed pods to relieve pressure. applying now.
SRE-oncall: FYI autoscaler didn't trigger because HPA metrics were delayed (metrics server errors). I'm restarting metrics-server.
Ashley: executed:
```
kubectl scale deploy/embedder --replicas=12 -n inference
kubectl rollout restart deploy/embedder -n inference
```
deploy-bot: rollout restarted for deployment embedder (rev: r47 -> r48) by Ashley
Mike: looking at heap profiles now. also running a canary rollback plan if new deploy is suspect. any recent deploys to embedder in the last hour?
Ashley: yes, r47 rolled ~40m ago. behavior started ~15m ago. possible memory regression.
Mike: I'll request a rollback to r45 (two revs back) as a precaution. initiating now.
deploy-bot: rollback started: embedder -> r45 (requested by Mike). ETA ~3m
support-bot: created support ticket #7890 for PDINC-2026-142; added customer orgs: org-114, org-209. Laura assigned.
Jordan: while rollback runs, I triggered a cache flush on redis shards and bumped connection pool size temporarily.
Ashley: redis flush command run on shard-3. logs show connection errors decreasing.
Mike: rollback successful, pods stabilized. quick health checks:
```
curl -sS http://embedder-eu-west-1/healthz
{"status":"ok","uptime_s":1234}
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embed
# all embedder pods now Running, no CrashLoop
```
Mike: p95 latency down to 2.3s, 5xx rate ~0.3% (was 1.4%). continuing to monitor. removing PD ack escalate? we should keep PD open until watch window ends.
Ashley: agreed. handing ownership to Mike for 30m watch window. @Mike you'll lead follow-ups and post any RCA notes.
Mike: I have it. I'll collect heap dumps, correlate with deploy delta, and prepare notes. running heap dump pull now.
Laura: customer comms updated: "Performance restored for most customers in EU; rollback deployed and engineers monitoring. We'll follow up with a root cause and timeline." sent via #support-updates :email: 
SRE-oncall: metrics-server restart fixed HPA gap, autoscaling should be functional now. confirmed HPA events are being emitted.
Mike: pulling one heap snapshot and seeing a large retained set from cache eviction logic (suspect leak in last deploy). saving artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-rca/PDINC-2026-142/heap-7164123456.tar.gz
Jordan: also instrumented a short profiler to watch goroutine growth for next 20m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalated to tier2 after 5m without resolution. (escalation policy triggered)
Ashley: note for postmortem: timeline, deploy r47->r48, memory regression in kv-cache flush -> pod OOMs -> autoscaler gap due to metrics-server flapping -> manual scale/rollback mitigations.
Mike: confirmed fix by rollback and cache tweak. I'll author a draft RCA after watch window. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for model/cache changes review.
Laura: prepping customer follow-up template and ETA for RCA (tentative 24h). adding impacted customer list to ticket #7890.
support-bot: ticket #7890 updated with post-rollback status and current metrics snapshot.
Ashley: thumbs up. we'll keep this thread for timeline+actions. @Mike ping here with final RCA draft and links to dumps.
Mike: will do. monitoring 30m window now. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: PDINC-2026-142 status changed to "monitoring" (ack by Ashley -> assigned to Mike). last update recorded.
-- 30 minutes later --
Mike: closing loop — metrics stable for 30m, no reoccurrence. I'll publish RCA draft in #postmortems and attach heap dumps/logs. closing PD incident in 10m if no regressions.
Ashley: thanks everyone. nice quick relay and rollback. we'll follow up on a longer-term fix (patch leak + add unit tests + canary policy).
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PDINC-2026-142 resolved by Mike. resolution: rollback to r45 + cache param adjustment + metrics-server restart."
